text:
Hi arrivals team,
The desk staff recorded a concern about desk cover at closing

Please make sure the handover notes are kept clear and that any pending pet travel checks are passed along before the desk is wrapped up. For the Companion Animal Travel Desk, a steady closeout helps us avoid missed updates and keeps travelers supported with calm, respectful communication.

If a case is still open when cover changes, please note the latest contact details, the animal status, and any special handling points in the shared log. This will help the next team member continue smoothly and keep Aurelia Skyways aligned with our service standards. Thanks for staying attentive and for supporting one another during the end-of-day flow.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
